summary: Profusa, Inc. filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026 (items 1.01, 2.03, 9.01) disclosing Amendment No. 4, dated November 5, 2026, to its Note Modification and Conversion Agreement with NorthView Sponsor I LLC, holder of a promissory note originally up to $2.5 million. The amendment resets the conversion price to the greater of a $0.20 floor and the closing price on the trading day before the conversion notice, after prior amendments set a 49.9% beneficial ownership cap and 122% conversion premium. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or change-of-control terms are stated. This is a routine debt-modification current report, not a special situation; watch dilution and conversion mechanics.
